mentions.description: A DMARC email authentication service focused on API access and integrations. The author is exploring adding an ML classifier to classify email sources and using RAG to automatically generate SPF/DKIM fix advice for different sources.

mentions.name: DMARC Defender
mentions.description: A DMARC email authentication service positioned as a cheaper alternative to existing DMARC tools, with no 'SSO tax' (no extra fees charged for SSO support).
